cass-wetlands-dnr-2018.geojson.caveats: MN DNR Wetlands Inventory (2018) via the county service. County version of the NWI: the viewer already has the USFWS NWI (71,539 polygons, fish/wildlife wire-in) -- the county DNR 2018 inventory is a different vintage/source and adds the county's own wetland typing. NWI is not a legal or regulatory delineation. FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
